acceptanceCriteria: Owner decision recorded: add a summary surface with a stated contract, or close as not needed.
body:
## Question

GitHub 446 offered a cheap `queue status --summary` for pollers as an optional relief. CAL-V0-059..061 bring the full `queue status` to about 0.25 s on a 1,829-receipt store, so the summary was not added. A summary could only skip the item projection, not the snapshot protocol that now dominates.

Decide whether pollers (dashboards, dispatcher loops) still need a reduced output, and what it may omit.
title: corvint-tasks: decide whether `queue status --summary` is still needed
